Each query is my single attempt from the page, with nothing run. I used `J1`…`J14` as labels because the tasks are named J, not H.

J1: /data | filter ~(/active | eq true) | filter ~(/address/city !| null | type | eq ::string) | sort ~(/name | lower) | * /name
J2: filter ~(/status | lower !| "" | eq "paid") | * (/items * (mul /price /qty) | sum) | sum | round 2
J3: :d /devDependencies | /dependencies | combine d | filter ~(startsWith "^") | :m / | keys | sort | * (:k / | keyword | append "@" | append (m | at k))
J4: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | * (/assignee/login !| "unassigned") | groupBy ~(/) | * count
J5: :d /defaults | /services | filter ~(/enabled !| true | eq true) | * {:name /name :timeout (at :timeout | coalesce (d | /timeout)) :retries (at :retries | coalesce (d | /retries))} | sort ~(/name)
J6: filter ~(at :durationMs | type | eq ::number) | groupBy ~(/service) | * (* /durationMs | :v / | sum | div (v | count) | round 1)
J7: filter ~(at :stock | type | eq ::number) | filter ~(/stock | gt 0) | sort ~(/price) | reverse | take 3 | * /name
J8: groupBy ~(/dept) | * (* (at :skills | coalesce []) | flat | * lower | distinct | sort)
J9: filter ~(/role | lower | eq "db") | every ~([(/region | eq "eu-west") (/cpu/cores | gte 8)] | every ~(eq true))
J10: "Alice@Example.com, bob@test.org; carol@EXAMPLE.com, dave@mail.net; erin@Test.org, frank@example.com" | split ";" | * (split ",") | flat | * (split "@" | last | lower) | distinct | sort
J11: lines | filter ~(count | gt 0) | * (split " ") | filter ~(/3 | parseJson | gte 500) | * /2 | :ps / | distinct | * (:p / | {:path p :count (ps | filter ~(eq p) | count)}) | sort ~([(/count | mul -1) /path]) | take 2
J12: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(count | gt 0) | * (split ",") | filter ~(/2 | count | gt 0) | groupBy ~(/1) | * (* (/2 | parseJson) | :v / | sum | div (v | count) | round 2)
J13: lines | filter ~(count | gt 0) | filter ~(startsWith "#" | not) | filter ~(contains "==") | * (split "==") | indexBy ~(/0 | lower) | * /1
J14: sort ~(at :comments | coalesce [] | * (at :likes | coalesce 0) | sum) | last | /title
